heroSlides.subtitle: Specialists in modern joinery and bespoke kitchens in Douala. Contemporary furniture, roofing and exceptional fit-outs in noble Cameroonian wood.
Central islands, clean fronts and smart storage: we design your kitchen in 3D before crafting it in 100% water-resistant wood, built for the Cameroonian climate.
We source our species from local suppliers, dry them with care and work them in our Douala workshop to reveal their unique grain.
Bookshelves, TV units, headboards, optimised wardrobes and wooden ceilings: one coherent world, designed for your space and exact dimensions.
From Douala to Yaoundé, Bafoussam and beyond: mastered workshop production, nationwide delivery and secure payment via Orange Money or MTN MoMo.
